descriptionChirho: A Hebrew proper name meaning 'YHWH has given' or 'fire of YHWH,' referring to multiple individuals in the Hebrew Bible, most prominently Joash king of Judah (son of Ahaziah, hidden in the temple by Jehosheba) and Joash king of Israel (son of Jehoahaz). With 47 occurrences, all three clusters represent the same proper noun in different grammatical frames: nominative and with prepositions, with lamed-preposition ('of Yoash'), and with conjunction ('and Yoash') (eng 'Yoash/Joash,' spa 'Joás/Yoash,' arb 'يُوآشَ,' kor '요아시/요아스,' swa 'Yoashi,' hin 'योआश').
